action-permission-denied: You don’t have permission for this action.
invite-drop-file: Drag a CSV or Excel file here, or browse
invite-file-columns-hint: Columns: email, roles — separate multiple roles with ; or |
invite-import-empty: That file is empty. Add at least one row with an email address.
invite-import-invalid-type: Unsupported file type. Choose a CSV or Excel file.
invite-import-no-email-column: That file has no "email" column. Use the columns email, roles.
invite-import-no-sheet: That Excel file has no worksheet. Export it again or use the CSV template.
invite-import-parse-failed: We couldn't read that file. Check the format and try again.
invite-import-too-large: This file is too large. Choose a file under 2 MB.
invite-import-too-many-role-names: That file lists too many unique role names ({{count}}; the limit is {{limit}}). Reduce the number of distinct roles and try again.
invite-import-unreadable-excel: That Excel file is unreadable. Export it again or use the CSV template.
invite-invalid-cell-boolean-no-cell: Column "{{column}}" contains a boolean ({{value}}), not text. Replace it with a text value, then try again.
invite-invalid-cell-boolean-with-cell: Column "{{column}}" (cell {{cell}}) contains a boolean ({{value}}), not text. Replace it with a text value, then try again.
invite-invalid-cell-error-no-cell: Column "{{column}}" contains a formula error ({{value}}). Fix the formula, then try again.
invite-invalid-cell-error-with-cell: Column "{{column}}" (cell {{cell}}) contains a formula error ({{value}}). Fix the formula, then try again.
invite-invalid-email: Row for {{email}} is not a valid email address. Fix the address, then try again.
invite-unresolved-role-ambiguous: "{{names}}" matches more than one role. Rename one of them, then re-add the file.
invite-unresolved-role-not-found: No role named {{names}}. Fix or remove it before sending.
bulk-action-total-failure-no-reason: The server didn't specify a reason for this failure. Try again, or contact support if the problem persists.
icon-guard-indeterminate-detached: {{context}}: icon element is not connected to the document, so its visibility cannot be measured. Expected action: attach the element to the document (render it in a live container) and re-run the guard.
icon-guard-indeterminate-unresolved: {{context}}: computed style value is unresolved (empty), so the icon's visibility cannot be measured. Expected action: make sure the element's computed style can be read (connected node, resolved stylesheet), then re-run the guard.
